purpose: Teach: 釈迦/マイノリティ/駐屯/寒冷/怠惰/連呼/取り締まる/量子力学

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、釈迦の教えと近代社会を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the Buddha's teachings and modern society, didn't you?
lines.style: Even, curious tone. Patient opening. Reads his work with genuine interest. Steady pace, no pressure in the question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、社会的マイノリティの権利史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the history of minority rights in society.
lines.style: Careful, precise. Opens with deference but settles into conviction. Takes his topic seriously. Even rhythm, no apology in the admission.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下の駐屯地の実態を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the actual conditions of military garrisons during wartime, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before his name. Slower pace. The question carries weight — she's noting something unexpected. Slightly impressed undertone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、寒冷地での生活適応研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on how people adapt to life in cold climates.
lines.style: Quick correction, but not defensive. Matter-of-fact rhythm. Accepts the mismatch without explanation. Solid, straightforward.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政治家の怠惰を批判した文献を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote your paper criticizing politicians' laziness, didn't you?
lines.style: Direct, slightly sharper. Alert to contradiction. The opening is faster — she's building a pattern. Engaged but controlled tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、選挙キャンペーンでの連呼戦略を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on repetition strategies used in election campaigns.
lines.style: Steady, factual. No defensiveness. Continues the pattern of quiet corrections. Unhurried rhythm.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、犯罪を取り締まる近代警察制度を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on modern police systems for controlling crime, didn't you?
lines.style: Weighted opening. Pause on his name. The final question — slower, more deliberate. Waiting to see what comes next.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、量子力学の発展史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the development and history of quantum mechanics.
lines.style: Final answer: calm, matter-of-fact. A slight closure in the tone. He's said what he needed to. Steady landing.
